**q25.** Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) via the in-repo memo filter engine in `internal/filter` (`engine.go`, `schema.go`, `parser.go`, `ir.go`, `render.go`; docs in `internal/filter/README.md`). Mechanism: the CEL expression is parsed and schema-validated, normalized into a dialect-agnostic IR, then rendered to a SQL fragment + args for a target dialect — the store drivers call `filter.DefaultEngine()` + `filter.AppendConditions(..., filter.DialectSQLite|DialectPostgres|DialectMySQL, &where, &args)` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:54-58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:65-69`) so dialect differences (placeholders `?` vs `$n`, JSON access, `LIKE` vs `ILIKE`, tag containment) live in `internal/filter/render.go`.

**q26.** `memo_relation` (both directions), `attachment`, `memo` (comment memos, then the memo row itself) — `store/memo.go:140-158`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:567-580`. `memo_share` is removed by the DB-level `FOREIGN KEY (memo_id) REFERENCES memo(id) ON DELETE CASCADE` on postgres/mysql (`store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:108`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:108`); on SQLite the constraint is declared but foreign keys are disabled in the DSN (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`), so those rows are not cascaded there. `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but never deleted (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:545`).

**q27.** Mechanism: the built `web/dist` output is compiled into the binary with `go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware plus an SPA `index.html` fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-22` (embed), `:40-59` (`Serve`, `StaticWithConfig` + `spaFallbackMiddleware`), invoked from `server/server.go:70`.

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner — server/server.go:161-171: RunOnce(ctx) at startup, then Run(ctx) loops on a time.Ticker of 12h (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41)
```
Not server-started scheduling infrastructure:
- `internal/scheduler` (cron-style scheduler with job/parser/middleware) is referenced only by its own tests — no production caller.
- `server/runner/memopayload` defines a `Runner` with `NewRunner`/`RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:19,27`) that is never started; only its plain helper `RebuildMemoPayload` is used (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`).
- (Not a "runner", but 4 webhook dispatch goroutines start via package `init()` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:42`, independent of the server.)

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:148-172` (token storage/expiry in `web/src/auth-state.ts`; proactive refresh hook `web/src/hooks/useTokenRefreshOnFocus.ts`). It attaches `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`, refreshes via `AuthService.refreshToken` on expiry or a 401 (deduped, one retry via `X-Retry`), and sends the HTTP-only refresh-token cookie through `credentials: "include"`. Token kinds: short-lived JWT access tokens (15 min), long-lived refresh tokens in the `memos_refresh` cookie (30 days), and Personal Access Tokens (`memos_pat_` prefix) for programmatic clients. Backend validation: `server/auth` (`token.go`, `authenticator.go`, `extract.go`), invoked through `NewAuthorizer`/`NewAuthInterceptor` in `server/router/api/v1/authz.go` and `connect_interceptors.go` (wired at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:66,131-136`).
